name: TypeScript
description: Installs TypeScript and ts-node as global npm packages, and configures VS Code for TypeScript/JavaScript development (ESLint, formatter defaults). Requires Node.js / npm to be installed first.

typescript.description: TypeScript version. 'latest' is resolved at build time and may change between rebuilds; use an exact version for stability, or 'none' to skip.

ts-node.description: ts-node version. 'latest' is resolved at build time and may change between rebuilds; use an exact version for stability, or 'none' to skip.
